heading: Today
text: Any valley fog burning off in the morning. Mostly sunny with a few clouds developing in southeastern Vermont in the afternoon. Mild. Highs from the mid to upper 50s. Light and variable wind.

heading: Tonight
text: Chance of valley fog. Mostly clear north and west, a few clouds moving in in the south and east. Lows from the low to mid 30s, a few upper 20s in the cold spots. Calm wind turning north at 5 mph.

heading: Thursday
text: Periods of sunshine mixing with clouds. Highs in the 50s, nearing 60 in the warmer southern valleys. North wind increasing to 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 25 mph, stronger gusts expected along Lake Champlain and over the higher hills.
